<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/client`, `@objectstack/runtime`, touching **4** documentable anchor(s).

**2** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx`  _(via /:commitId/revert (route, a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`  _(via handlePackagesRequest (symbol, a top-level function), /:commitId/revert (route, a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-1.mdx`  _(via revertCommit (sdk, the bare tail of client method packages.revertCommit, bound to POST /packages/:id/commits/:commitId/revert))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **212** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **39** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ea74ebf93f8b1b955b2b77327c3a34c677d4d751` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `bc9a2306c9bc09131c52c18316ef4cbf194c5f33` — the merge of head `4f64ab7c64284373fb9c8a5310e8c8abf805e8a0` into base `ea74ebf93f8b1b955b2b77327c3a34c677d4d751`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin bc9a2306c9bc09131c52c18316ef4cbf194c5f33 && git checkout bc9a2306c9bc09131c52c18316ef4cbf194c5f33
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin ea74ebf93f8b1b955b2b77327c3a34c677d4d751 4f64ab7c64284373fb9c8a5310e8c8abf805e8a0 && git checkout -B drift-repro ea74ebf93f8b1b955b2b77327c3a34c677d4d751 && git merge --no-ff 4f64ab7c64284373fb9c8a5310e8c8abf805e8a0

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ea74ebf93f8b1b955b2b77327c3a34c677d4d751
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs ea74ebf93f8b1b955b2b77327c3a34c677d4d751` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

ACCEPT · PR #28502 · Head-sha `4f64ab7c64284373fb9c8a5310e8c8abf805e8a0` · 2026-11-01T03:15Z

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 包的六个写入口（丢弃草稿、回退提交、回滚、认领孤儿元数据、复制包，以及发布草稿时的应用重存）在元数据历史和包提交里记登录用户，不再记请求体里的 `actor`；SDK 这五个方法的 `actor` 选项标为 deprecated。
- **为什么改：** 原来能改元数据的调用方可以在请求体里随便写一个名字，让改动看起来是别人做的；单条元数据入口早就只认登录身份。
- **风险与回滚：** 请求体的 `actor` 被忽略而不是拒绝，老客户端照常工作；无用户的系统调用仍记 `null`。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` 的 `resolvePackageWriteActor` 注释与六处调用；新测试 `packages-write-actor-session.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/packages-write-actor-session.test.ts`（17/17）。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

席位意见：六处都改用 N-06 已落地的同一个解析函数，没有第二份；每个入口单独消融验证；可合。

## 席位核对

- **Form:** 6 files, +204/-23. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 28502`: NOT governed, ≤ 3000 lines, Tier S. `Clause-②: no` holds (claim amendment on #28414): no `packages/spec` path; the client change is a `@deprecated` JSDoc on the `actor` member of five inline, unexported option types; a body `actor` is ignored, never refused. `Metadata-protocol: none` holds. `@objectstack/runtime` and `@objectstack/client` patch.
- **Premise measured:** the card's `:2074` is not a separate door but the app re-save inside `publish-drafts`; it is fixed here with that door's resolved actor, and `protocol.publishPackageDrafts` itself was N-06's. No spec request schema declares `actor`, so Wanted 3 has no diff. No caller acts on behalf of another identity through these doors (console and SDK send none, the CLI calls none), so Wanted 2 names no server-side path.
- **Gates (check-runs at the pinned head):** 48 runs: 38 success, 10 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending; mergeable, clean. Dev: 61/61 gates run, 0 NOT MEASURED, after a full build; `pnpm lint` 0; runtime and client typecheck green; client 689/689; the new file 17/17, six per-door ablations each red at its own door.
- **Accepted deviations:** two stale pins flipped (the http-dispatcher commit-revert routing case, and #28447's conformance pin, which said to flip when this card landed). Merge commit `881d0d31` skipped `.githooks/pre-commit` by a hook-path override; the dev ran its one check by hand afterwards, exit 0, and the PR records it.
- **Out of scope and where it goes:** the change note and Studio's history display name stay with N-06; `sys_audit` actor capture is a different writer. `Skills-docs: none`.
- **Landing clause:** Tier S ordinary queue landing. The seat flips ready and enables auto-merge through the relay, then confirms MERGED and closes out #28414.
